precepts.text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the Sabbath day, that they might find an accusation against him.
precepts.point: And they watched him. Who is the they that watched him? The Pharisees. So they was always looking for accusations against Christ. Following him, following him, seeing is he going to slip up that we might accuse him. Remember what Christ said: if they do it unto you, surely they have done it unto me. They follow you block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner; surely they have done it unto Christ.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
Mark says “they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.” Who is the they that watched him? Luke names them: “And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.”

The scribes and Pharisees were always looking for accusations against Christ. Following him, following him, watching to see if he would slip up so they could accuse him.

Remember what Christ said: if they do it unto you, surely they have done it unto me. They follow us block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner, looking for something to accuse. Surely they did it unto Christ first.

precepts.text: They were trying to get him to come out of the spirit. They were trying to get Christ to speak vehemently and say things that he should not say. But no, Christ kept it spiritual, according to the Bible, the way we should. Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth: trying to catch him, have him slip up in his speech. The same Pharisees back then are here today in 2026.

They follow you block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner; surely they have done it unto Christ.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
The Pharisees watched Christ in the synagogue so they might accuse him, and Luke shows how far they went: “the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things.” They were trying to get him to come out of the spirit, to speak vehemently and say things he should not say.

But no, Christ kept it spiritual, according to the Bible, the way we should.

“Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.” Trying to catch him and have him slip up in his speech. The same Pharisees back then are here today in 2026, provoking and laying wait for something to catch out of our mouths, and the answer is the same: stay in the spirit.

precepts.why:
They did not only watch Christ from the outside. “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.”

Spies pretending to be just men, sitting among his hearers, waiting to take hold of his words and hand him over to the governor.

Oh, we might have a few of them up in here. We might have a few of them up in our Atlanta congregation, New York congregation, Mississippi congregation. We know you're there, biding your time. The Pharisees watched Christ on the sabbath that they might accuse him, and they still send forth spies today, feigning themselves just men.

precepts.text: So the scribes came down from Jerusalem. They started to follow Christ from region to region.
precepts.point: It says, then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees which were of Jerusalem: meaning they came from Jerusalem, following Christ around, from place to place. Cuz I said they follow from state to state; soon it'll be country to country. Don't be shocked.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
Matthew says “Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem”: they came from Jerusalem, following Christ around from place to place. Mark shows the same thing: “And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.”

The scribes came down from Jerusalem. They started to follow Christ from region to region, not to learn from him but to accuse him and call his power the devil.

They do the same with us. They follow from state to state; soon it will be country to country. Don't be shocked.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord and against his anointed.
precepts.point: The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians how they might destroy him.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
“And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.” The Herodians were a Jewish political faction that supported the Herodian dynasty and aligned with Roman rule for political stability. Herod was an Idumean, the same Idumeans the Maccabees fought against, set up as Edomite kings over us. And these Jews aligned themselves with the Herodians and the Romans ruling over us.

David saw it: “Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing? The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed.” The kings of the earth are the nations. The rulers are those of our people in the pockets, in the creature comforts, of white supremacy, heathen supremacy. Against the Lord and against his anointed: against Christ and his followers.

“Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” Let us defame them, mock them, make them look bad, call them a hate group, call them racial idolaters. Cast away their cords: stop their teachings.

We have Herodians today: our people who desire and fight for the white man to reign over us by any means necessary. Officer Tatum, who said he would not cry over a loved one, then cried when Charlie Kirk died, and supports Israel. Mayweather too. Anton Daniels, who defends Trump to the death. Fresh and Fit, Charleston White, Candace Owens, jumping from one thing to the next with divided loyalties. Avery, crying over Charlie Kirk, a man who spoke evil of black people to the day he died. Jason Whitlock, who threw out the term racial idolatry.

These are financial idolaters. They worship money and the white man and the power he gives them financially. All skinfolk ain't kinfolk: like the Pharisees who took counsel with the Herodians against Christ, they take counsel with the kings of the earth against the Lord and against his anointed.

precepts.text: Ye shall be brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
precepts.point: The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians how they might destroy him.

note.label: All Skinfolk Ain't Kinfolk: Children of Darkness

precepts.why:
The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians against Christ, and Christ told his followers they would face the same. Mark says: “they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.” The rulers are our own people; the kings are the heathen, like Herod and the Caesars, like Nero. The testimony is against them both, the heathen and our own people, through the scriptures.

Luke says it too: “But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.” Kings like Agrippa; rulers like the Pharisees, the Sadducees and the scribes.

Why do the rulers of our own people do this? Isaiah says, “For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.” They were evil and rebellious then and they are evil and rebellious now. They are the builders: “The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.” The rulers, whose eyes he covered in darkness because they were wicked, refused Christ.

So when the followers of Christ are mocked, defamed and delivered up by their own skinfolk to the kings of the earth, it is the same thing that was done to Christ. They are brought before kings and rulers for his name's sake, for a testimony against them.

points: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man. You are the strong man of your house. When you as the leader of the house are watching porn, it does not just affect you. It affects your wife, it affects your kids, and you do not even see it. You are inviting demons into your house; all of a sudden your kids start acting different and your wife has demons on her. Why? Because you opened that door.

Much worse, she opens your phone one time and sees that thing on your phone. Now she is saying, you do not find me attractive, you do not desire me, and she starts dealing with low self esteem. Porn will destroy our marriages. It is not worth it. When you open that door, you are allowing Satan up in your house.

Satan tells you it is not that bad, you are not literally sleeping with another woman, it is just something you are watching. That is Satan making you downplay it, but really and truly it is destroying your house.

Mark, Peter's scribe historically, gives the same account as Matthew 12 with more detail. The scribes said, he hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils. Christ asked, how can Satan cast out Satan?

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: If a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand: that is why we fell as a nation. And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end. You see the nations that oppressed us turning against each other in this hour; Satan divided against himself has an end.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: Verily I say unto you, all sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme: but he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation: because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: That last line is the key: because they said he hath an unclean spirit. They were saying the Holy Spirit he healed with was the devil. If they maintained that mindset to death, that was it for them. That is what blasphemy against the Holy Ghost is.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

points: Satan attacks unity. That is why the scripture says we are not ignorant of his devices. Any good event, anything positive, Satan tries to come in and ruin it, because he hates us unified.

If a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand. Imagine a body divided against itself; can you imagine punching yourself in the nose? A definition of autoimmune disease was read: a condition where your immune system mistakenly attacks your own healthy cells, tissues, and organs. What do we look like gnashing and biting against one another, working against each other, trying to step over each other for rank, position, authority, or pride? You got an autoimmune disease in the body when you work against yourself. Everybody is getting a crown, but you want a bigger crown; you better just try to get in the door. That is the mission: get in the door.

A PowerPoint was shown on the clear signs that a body is fractured or fracturing: constant murmuring; cliques forming, where brothers do not want other brothers around; isolation, people distancing themselves; secret conversations and hidden discussions; prideful individualism, people that cannot be corrected; emotional decision making instead of doing it scripturally; lying or dealing falsely; and refusal to forgive. Holding a grudge destroys the body; we have to forgive like Christ told us to forgive.

Then the signs of a healthy body, fitly joined together: healthy communication; patience, members forbearing one another; forgiveness, moving past things without holding them over each other's heads; structured leadership; congregational support, showing up when a brother needs help; humility, where a teacher that does not know an answer says I do not know instead of freestyling a made-up answer that creates a breakdown; shared mission, because a body that understands the goal is the strongest body; and endurance through pressure, which reveals faith, strengthens unity, and develops spiritual maturity. Those that have been through some things and are still standing, we see you: not easily moved, a rock, standing on Christ.
A house divided against itself cannot stand: America is a great house of all nations, and it is not united as you think; their own movie Civil War shows it.

If Satan rise up against himself and be divided, he cannot stand: Esau's sons fighting each other is not our fight. Trump looks foolish threatening bombs one moment and agreeing the next, but do not sleep on Esau; it is God that takes them down.
The Pharisees took counsel with the Herodians how they might destroy him.
